gloss: to throw in; to toss into

definitions.gloss: to throw in; to toss into
definitions.explanation: To throw something carelessly or forcefully into a container or space.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{洗濯機|せんたくき}に{放|ほう}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I tossed the laundry into the washing machine.

examples.japanese: ゴミを{袋|ふくろ}に{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む。
examples.english: I throw the garbage into the bag.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}に{野菜|やさい}を{次々|つぎつぎ}と{放|ほう}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I threw vegetables into the pot one after another.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む → {放|ほう}り{込|こ}まない (negative)
・{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む → {放|ほう}り{込|こ}んで (te-form)
・{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む → {放|ほう}り{込|こ}んだ (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {放|ほう}る (to throw) + {込|こ}む (into)

USAGE:
Implies carelessness or haste in the action:
・カバンに{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む (to toss into a bag)
・{車|くるま}に{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む (to throw into the car)
・{牢屋|ろうや}に{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む (to throw in jail - figurative)

NUANCE:
More casual and forceful than {入|い}れる. Often suggests a rough or careless manner.
